context: This repository is the central brain of the Polvo 4.1 project — an autonomous content creation system for dark channels using AI agents. The goal is to build a fully automated pipeline from content discovery to publishing and learning. The repository is an Obsidian vault with wikilinks, Dataview, and Kanban.
language_convention: Planning/study notes are in pt-BR. Technical files (README, .opencode, scripts, metadata/properties, SOPs) are in EN. Agent definitions and prompts are in EN.
golden_rules: Monthly budget ceiling: R$300. Never exceed without explicit user approval.
Core paid tools: Claude Pro + CapCut Pro (~R$170-190). Remainder is compute fund for APIs/credits.
Always log decisions in 10_Changelog/Changelog.md before making major changes.
Agents run autonomously via n8n + MCP. This repo is memory, not runtime.
Every script, prompt, SOP, and agent definition must be versioned and tracked.

obsidian_features.dataview_queries: Used in Dashboard for dynamic status overview
obsidian_features.graph_view: Uses frontmatter properties (type, status, tags) for color grouping
obsidian_features.bases: Obsidian Bases plugin enabled for structured data on 08_Metricas/
